# Video Editor Revelation Plan

The Awtsmoos gives one purpose through many vessels bright;
Awtsmoos.com can split a crowded monolith and still preserve its light.
The old editor binds desktop rails to every screen it sees;
The new vessel keeps each feature whole while letting mobile breathe with ease.

## Proven defects

- Standalone document has no viewport meta declaration.
- `body` is locked to `height: 100vh`, fragile on mobile browser chrome.
- Media bin is a permanent 320px absolute rail.
- Timeline wrapper begins at `left: 340px`, so narrow screens cannot own a coherent workspace.
- Visible layers escalate through 1300, 1400, and 1500 instead of expressing a small semantic layer model.
- Bin and timeline toggles are `div` elements with click handlers rather than buttons.
- Core controls rely heavily on hover transforms without equivalent focus-visible treatment.
- The 648-line document mixes document structure, all styling, state, media importing, timeline geometry, drag/resize, caption rendering, scrubbing, and playback.

## Files to create / fully rewrite

- `apps/video-editor/index.html` — semantic shell, viewport metadata, accessible controls, module boot only.
- `apps/video-editor/css/tokens.css` — shared variables and semantic layer scale.
- `apps/video-editor/css/base.css` — reset, body, focus-visible, utility states.
- `apps/video-editor/css/layout.css` — desktop workspace geometry.
- `apps/video-editor/css/media-bin.css` — media panel and item presentation.
- `apps/video-editor/css/timeline.css` — timeline, playhead, clip geometry.
- `apps/video-editor/css/controls.css` — toolbar and panel buttons.
- `apps/video-editor/css/captions.css` — caption presentation.
- `apps/video-editor/css/responsive.css` — tablet/mobile/short-height behavior and safe areas.
- `apps/video-editor/js/OhrEditorState.js` — single application state vessel.
- `apps/video-editor/js/KliDom.js` — typed-by-name DOM reference collection.
- `apps/video-editor/js/ChesedTimelineScale.js` — scale and geometry calculations.
- `apps/video-editor/js/GevurahPanelController.js` — bin/timeline open, retracted, minimized behavior.
- `apps/video-editor/js/TiferesTimelineItem.js` — clip creation plus drag/resize interactions.
- `apps/video-editor/js/NetzachMediaImporter.js` — image/audio/alignment import flow.
- `apps/video-editor/js/HodScrubber.js` — scrub/pointer coordination.
- `apps/video-editor/js/YesodCaptionRenderer.js` — forced-alignment caption rendering.
- `apps/video-editor/js/MalchusPlaybackController.js` — playback, display refresh, cut flow.
- `apps/video-editor/js/app.js` — composition root.

## Behavioral preservation contract

- Existing file accept types remain audio, image, and JSON.
- `.awtsmoos.json` alignment fragments remain supported.
- First imported audio remains the playback source.
- Clicking image assets still creates five-second clips.
- Clip dragging and left/right resizing remain available for pointer and touch.
- Timeline clicking/touching still scrubs audio.
- Play, pause, and cut retain their existing semantics.
- Active forced-alignment words remain highlighted.
- Bin and timeline collapse/minimize controls remain available.

## UI improvement contract

- Mobile CSS viewport matches device width.
- No body-level horizontal overflow at 320px, 390px, 768px, or desktop.
- Media bin becomes a modal-like off-canvas drawer on narrow screens instead of consuming permanent width.
- Timeline uses full width on narrow screens.
- Playback controls wrap when needed and respect safe-area padding.
- All interactive buttons meet a minimum practical touch size.
- Keyboard focus is visible.
- Semantic layer scale replaces four-digit z-index escalation.
- Short-height layouts preserve access to the timeline and transport controls.

## Verification after code pass

1. Read every new/replaced file completely.
2. Check each code/CSS file line count; no source file may exceed 120 lines.
3. Run module syntax checks.
4. Serve the folder locally.
5. Verify desktop geometry at 1440x900.
6. Verify mobile geometry at 390x844 and 320x568.
7. Verify no document horizontal overflow.
8. Open and close the mobile media drawer.
9. Exercise timeline minimize/retract controls.
10. Inspect browser console.
11. Review git diff only for the Video Editor paths.
